items.followUp: Write one disadvantage of mesh topology.

rubric.why: Mesh topology provides reliable communication through dedicated links.
rubric.description: Identifies reliability or dedicated links as an advantage.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that mesh topology is reliable or has dedicated links between devices.

rubric.why: A link failure can be identified and isolated without disrupting the rest of the network.
rubric.description: Identifies easy fault detection or isolation.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that faults are easy to detect or isolate.

modelAnswer: Mesh topology is highly reliable because each device has a dedicated link to another device.
If a link fails, the fault can be detected and isolated easily without affecting the rest of the network.

items.followUp: What is the function of the Data Link Layer?

rubric.why: The Physical Layer is the first layer of the OSI model.
rubric.description: Identifies the Physical Layer as the first OSI layer.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that it is the first layer of the OSI model.

rubric.why: This layer transmits raw bits through the physical communication medium.
rubric.description: States that it transmits raw bits over a physical medium.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for describing the transmission of bits through a physical medium or channel.

modelAnswer: The Physical Layer is the first layer of the OSI model.
It transmits raw bits over the physical communication medium.

rubric.why: Copyright is a legal protection for the creator or author of original work.
rubric.description: States that copyright is legal protection for original work.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for identifying copyright as a legal right or protection belonging to the creator or author.

rubric.why: Copyright controls copying, reproduction, distribution or use of the protected work.
rubric.description: Explains that the right controls copying or use of the work.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that copying or using the work requires the copyright owner's permission, or is controlled by the owner.

modelAnswer: Copyright is the legal protection given to the creator of an original work.
It gives the creator control over copying, distributing or using the work, usually requiring permission from the copyright owner.
